summary:
Implemented the Maintenance/Garage handoff slice.

Added `maintenance.html#service-closeout`: four iPhone-friendly after-job shortcuts for oil, wheel/tire, battery, and filter work. Each one selects the existing Quick Maintenance Update type, prefills an editable completion note, scrolls to the form, and focuses mileage so saving still uses the existing Garage maintenance log path.

Updated search metadata, bumped the service-worker cache to `ridgeline-console-v342`, expanded smoke coverage, updated `AGENT_STATE.md`, and published `agent-last-run.json`.
